fix.intended_scope: Use actual macOS SDK and actual host target triple for a build-machine compiler; prove compile/link/execute before passing it to QEMU --host-cc, leaving SDKROOT and iOS target environment unchanged.
fix.implementation: Resolve absolute clang and MacOSX SDK using xcrun --sdk macosx; validate safe paths; query actual compiler default with clang -isysroot <MacSDK> -dumpmachine and accept arm64/aarch64 Apple Darwin/macOS only. Use explicit -target <that triple> -isysroot <MacSDK>.
fix.proof: Compile/link a real C program including TargetConditionals.h with #error unless TARGET_OS_OSX and not TARGET_OS_IPHONE; require a new nonempty executable, execute it and require exact IDECK_QEMU_HOST_COMPILER_OK output before publishing IDECK_QEMU_HOST_CC.
fix.triple_scope: Compiler default target validation, not independent proof of the running host OS. Conditional macros plus actual compile/link/execute supply the intended runnable compiler gate on Apple.
fix.transport: Reject unsafe path/triple tokens that QEMU meson_quote cannot faithfully transport rather than invent shell quoting.
fix.selection: Pass the proven command through QEMU documented --host-cc; no SDKROOT/CC/CFLAGS or iOS target compiler changes.
fix.receipt: Record resolved SDK/compiler/triple, inherited SDKROOT as observed on future runner, probe size/hash/stdout and recipe patch hash; no invented value for previous failing run.
fix.failure_behavior: Compiler/SDK resolution, paths/triple, platform macros, compile/link/execute errors, unexpected output or timeout fail closed; do not publish host compiler before success.
